summary: One Blocker, and it is a test gap, not a code fault. The Phase 13 code (commit 993d9642, 6 files) matches spec FR 1 to FR 7 and M2 to M7: the opt-in kinds with the Phase 12 default, the b0-s<jj> paths, the provenance merge with the header guard and the per-clip write, the M5 skip rule, the M6 call/sent/kept lines in both makers, and the readalong-sentence-clips row with the F7 closure. The reruns hold: the 15 Green mutants are all caught (15 of 15, each restore equal by cmp), my own probes R1 and R3 are caught, and the baseline gives 51 passed at HEAD. My probe R4 (the skip rule drops the text compare of M5) SURVIVES all 51 tests: no test pins the 'same text' half of M5. A regression would silently keep a stale clip for a changed sentence text; the check row would fail later (text differs), so no wrong package ships, but the maker contract of M5 and the AC13-11 sums would break silently. Fix: one Red retry case in N3. My probe R2 (--kind all maps to readalong only) also survives the unit file but is caught by the committed live proof of the same commit. Three Nits. All content points (M2 on the 72 clips, sent lines against captures, p13-chars.txt, the cut probe) stay deferred to round 2.
blocking_findings: F1 [Major] FIX (test, a Red retry before the Clips task; no code change, no shipped file change). Spec M5 defines a done sentence as an item with the same file AND the same text AND the matching SHA-256. The test file pins the file half (N2 made paths) and the hash half (N3 'a done sentence whose mp3 hash differs is made again', mutant M6), but no case pins the text half: my own mutant R4 (dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-sentence-clips.ts:344, `if (!row || row.text !== item.text) return false;` changed to `if (!row) return false;`) SURVIVES the full readalong test file (51 passed, exit 0; p13-review-a-mutants.txt). The 15 Green mutants do not name it either. A regression would silently skip a remake when a sentence text changed with an unchanged file: the maker would log kept, send no characters, and the AC13-11 sums would agree; the week field would keep the old text and the readalong-sentence-clips row would fail at check-weeks (text differs), so a wrong package cannot ship silently. Disposition: FIX (test) - add one N3 case: a done sentence whose item text differs from the book sentence is made again, with the exact call and kept lines. Route: Red retry, then Green needs no code change.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] accept (evidence: the committed live proof of the same commit). The flag mapping `--kind all` to both kinds (M3) has no unit case: my probe R2 (make-sentence-clips.ts:113, `all: ['decodable', 'readalong'],` changed to `all: ['readalong'],`) SURVIVES the readalong test file (51 passed). It is caught by the Green 1 live proof: p13-green1-live.py lines 76-86 require the `all` dry run to print 8 kept decodable lines plus the read-along list and the read-along chars, and p13-green1-live.txt lines 17-23 hold this pass for w01 to w07. A unit case for `--kind all` can ride the same Red retry as F1, but the behavior is proven at the Green commit.

F3 [Nit] FIX (test, cosmetic; can ride the same Red retry). dashboard/__tests__/storytime-package-readalong-clips.test.ts:1414 - the it name 'a fake that throws on call 2 gives 1 call line and the failed sent line' contradicts its body, which asserts 2 call lines (call 1 fan, call 2 hen) and `sent: 6 (run failed)` per M6 (a failed call is counted because the call line is added before the call). The test is correct; the name is stale from before Red retry R1 (defect D5). Rename to 'gives 2 call lines'.

F4 [Nit] accept. measure/tracks/storytime_week_package_20261022/test-strategy.md has no Phase 13 section; its full detail stops at Phase 10. The Phase 13 plan section carries the process, and the P13 Red 1 log applies the A3/A4 rules (labeled counts, the characterization list). No gap follows; a strategy refresh is the strategy role's job, not this phase's.
